info.about: Worms Armageddon is a 1999 turn-based strategy video game developed and published by Team17 as part of the Worms series. It was originally released for the Microsoft Windows operating system, and was later ported to the PlayStation, Dreamcast, Nintendo 64, and Game Boy Color.
info.trivia: A late Infogrames release, arriving in 2000 when few third parties were still publishing on the system.
info.why: A small print run and no other way to own this version make it one of the pricier third-party carts.
